projects.title: End-to-End Accessibility Evaluation Platform
projects.description: This project aims to build a minimum viable end-to-end accessibility evaluation platform based on WCAG-EM and EU public-sector monitoring requirements. The system integrates normative evaluation with user disability profiles to improve both the efficiency and effectiveness of accessibility audits. The platform will guide the evaluation from initial configuration (scope, standards, user profiles), through system exploration and sampling, to profile-driven auditing and traceable reporting. The result is a defensible accessibility evaluation workflow that mirrors how expert evaluators reason in real audits.
keyFeatures: WCAG-EM-based evaluation workflow
Support for screening and in-depth audits
Disability-profile-driven test planning
Automated and assisted auditing
Traceable reports and structured datasets
Support for longitudinal monitoring and observatories
projects.expectedOutcome: A working prototype that evaluates a real website from URL to final report, producing a conformance verdict, evidence-based reports, and structured datasets for comparison and historical analysis.

projects.title: Configuration & Disability Profile Engine
projects.description: Develop the configuration core of the evaluation system, including scope definition, normative targets, and disability profiles as a first-class input. This project focuses on how evaluation strategy is defined before any crawling or auditing begins.
keyFeatures: Configuration models for WCAG, EN 301 549, and legal contexts
Disability profile catalogue (visual, motor, cognitive, etc.)
Mapping profiles to criteria, test types, and assistive technologies
Generation of a profile-aware test matrix
projects.expectedOutcome: A reusable configuration module that defines what and how the system will evaluate accessibility in a structured and traceable manner.

projects.title: System Exploration & Inventory Builder
projects.description: Build an intelligent exploration engine that analyses a website as a system rather than as isolated pages. The tool identifies page types, common templates, key functionalities, and complete user flows to support representative accessibility sampling.
keyFeatures: Controlled crawling within defined scope
Automatic detection of mandatory pages (home, contact, accessibility statement, feedback)
Identification of forms, multimedia, and dynamic components
Export of a structured inventory for sampling and auditing
projects.expectedOutcome: A reusable and structured system inventory that supports defensible sampling and accessibility auditing workflows.

projects.title: Reporting & Dataset Generator
projects.description: Transform raw accessibility audit results into normative reports and profile-oriented insights. This project focuses on reporting clarity, traceability, and structured data reuse for monitoring and observatories.
keyFeatures: Generation of technical WCAG-based audit reports
Impact summaries per disability profile
Structured exports (JSON, CSV)
Support for historical comparison and longitudinal analysis
projects.expectedOutcome: A reporting module that converts accessibility evaluation data into actionable, traceable, and comparable outputs.

projects.title: In-Depth Sampling Engine
projects.description: Implement the micro-sampling rules required for in-depth accessibility audits, particularly those defined in EU Decision 2018/1524. The system must generate defensible and legally compliant audit samples.
keyFeatures: Selection of mandatory pages when available
Detection of complete user processes
Random sampling extension (+10%)
Export of a defensible sample table
projects.expectedOutcome: A standalone sampling module capable of generating legally robust and traceable audit samples.

projects.title: Profile-Driven Test Matrix Generator
projects.description: Develop the core logic that converts normative accessibility requirements combined with disability profiles into an executable and prioritised test matrix for auditors.
keyFeatures: Profile to criteria to test to assistive technology mapping
Priority calculation based on user impact
Output compatible with automated and manual auditing tools
projects.expectedOutcome: A focused engine that transforms accessibility requirements into an efficient and user-centred audit matrix.

projects.title: Mandatory Page Detector
projects.description: Automatically detect mandatory pages such as accessibility statements, contact pages, or feedback mechanisms to support legal compliance and defensible sampling in accessibility audits.
keyFeatures: Detection of accessibility statements
Detection of contact and feedback pages
Pattern-based identification of legally required content
Integration with system inventory builder
projects.expectedOutcome: A helper module that improves compliance detection and strengthens accessibility audit defensibility.
